probes.DELETE /api/platform/complaints/:id id:i: By design (awaiting the tech lead): a complaint is never deleted, so DELETE answers 405 COMPLAINT_KEPT for every id, malformed or not; the same answer for any id says nothing about which ids exist (PF-21w).
probes.GET /api/public/invitations/:token id:to: By design (awaiting the tech lead): an invitation token is a 256-bit random string, not a uuid; a token that is not live answers 200 with its state (NOT_VALID for an unknown or malformed one, EXPIRED for an expired one), so the accept page shows its own words and a bad token tells nothing (PF-4b).
probes.POST /api/front-office/conflict-checks/:: By design (awaiting the tech lead): {} is a valid confirm body when the check already has its result (the result is needed only while it is unset; the confirm page sends result undefined then), so with the sweep's random id the honest answer is 404 (PF-28 part 3b).
probes.POST /api/front-office/prospects/:id/con: By design (awaiting the tech lead): {} is a valid Convert body (the version is optional; check_csk1s_clients_browser and check_fo13s_identity_browser send {}), so with the sweep's random id the honest answer is 404 (PF-28 part 3a).
probes.POST /api/front-office/prospects/:id/ret: By design (awaiting the tech lead): {} is a valid Prepare retainer (kind, template, representative, signer and fee rows all have defaults: the firm's active template, the caller if licensed, the prospect's person), so with the sweep's random prospect id the honest answer is 404; an unknown field, a wrong type and a malformed id are refused first (FO-5).
probes.POST /api/front-office/retainers/:id/dow: By design (awaiting the tech lead): {} is a valid download link (the current version's file), so with the sweep's random retainer id the honest answer is 404; an unknown field, a wrong type and a malformed id are refused first (FO-5, BR-15).
probes.POST /api/platform/session/callback miss: By design (awaiting the tech lead): a sign-in door answers its own status: no code is the callback's 401 SIGN_IN_CODE_REFUSED (check_forms_qa53 DOORS; batch 44935069729 on #2787), never a field error; an unknown field or a wrong type is still 422.
probes.POST /api/platform/staff/invitations/:id: By design (awaiting the tech lead): {} is a valid resend body (the reason is optional; the web sends {}), so with the sweep's random id the honest answer is 404; question on #2787.
probes.POST /api/public/bookings/:token/cancel: By design (awaiting the tech lead): {} is a valid cancel by link (the reason is optional; the manage page sends {} when none is typed), so with the sweep's unknown link the honest answer is the one not-found 404 (FO-3pa); an unknown field, a wrong type and a malformed link are refused first.
probes.POST /api/public/sign/:token/decline mis: By design (awaiting the tech lead): FO-5d (1): {} is a valid decline with no reason (the reason is optional, AG05-D4(7)), so with the sweep's unknown link the honest answer is the one not-found 404 "This link does not work."; an unknown field, a wrong type, a reason over 500 characters, a 1 MB body and a malformed link are refused first (tests/check_fo5d_decline_withdraw.ts D2).
probes.POST /api/public/sign/:token/code missin: By design (awaiting the tech lead): {} is a valid ask for a code on a signing link (resend is optional, and the journeys and the door's page send {}), so with the sweep's unknown link the honest answer is the one not-found 404 "This link does not work." (FO-6 part 4b); an unknown field, a wrong type, a 1 MB body and a malformed link are refused first.
probes.POST /api/public/forms/:token/submission: By design (awaiting the tech lead): the sweep's copy has no live web form (seeded forms are off and need a consent wording, and the door needs the page's origin), so its probes cannot reach this door; part 3b proves it on a live form in check_fo4_sales_browser (unknown field, wrong type, no submission id → 422 named, nothing stored) and check_fo2_leads_prospects (PF-28 part 3b).

probes.POST /api/public/invitations/:token/acce: By design (awaiting the tech lead): accepting a token that is not live answers 410 INVITATION_NOT_VALID, the same for a malformed, unknown, used or expired token (PF-4b, PF-6m2).
probes.POST /api/public/messages/ses-notices 1m: By design (awaiting the tech lead): the SNS door keeps AWS's own 300 KB limit and checks the signature first; an unsigned body is 400 'not signed by Amazon SNS' before anything is read (PF-19b part 2).
probes.POST /api/public/messages/ses-notices mi: By design (awaiting the tech lead): the SNS signature is checked before any field is read, so an unsigned body is 400 'not signed by Amazon SNS', never a field error (PF-19b part 2, AG-10-32).
probes.POST /api/public/messages/ses-notices un: By design (awaiting the tech lead): the SNS signature is checked before any field is read, so an unsigned body is 400 'not signed by Amazon SNS', never a field error (PF-19b part 2, AG-10-32).

probes.POST /api/system/staff/:id/end-sessions: By design (awaiting the tech lead): ruled by Lead 28 on #3487, 24 Nov: {} is a valid end-all-sessions body (ReasonBody in api/src/platform/system-identity/staff.ts has reason optional, and the route carries no @SystemReason), so with the sweep's random staff id the honest answer is 404; an unknown field, a wrong type and a malformed id are refused first (R1.10 A4).
probes.POST /api/system/staff/:id/reactivate mi: By design (awaiting the tech lead): ruled by Lead 28 on #3487, 24 Nov: {} is a valid reactivate body (ReasonBody in api/src/platform/system-identity/staff.ts has reason optional, and the route carries no @SystemReason), so with the sweep's random staff id the honest answer is 404; an unknown field, a wrong type and a malformed id are refused first (R1.10 A4).
probes.PUT /api/front-office/bookings/:id/consu: By design (awaiting the tech lead): {} is a valid first save of a consult record (every field is optional; a first save names no version), so with the sweep's random booking id the honest answer is 404; an unknown field and a wrong type are 422 before the booking is read (FO-3a 2a).
probes.POST /api/front-office/money/invoices/:i: By design (awaiting the tech lead): FO-7c part 2a (#3633): the pay link takes no field at all, because the client pays the full amount due (AG-6-14 rule 2), so {} is the valid body and a probe's unknown invoice id answers the one 404; any field sent is refused 422 and a body that is not JSON 415.
